021
022
023public class EnergyLashSystemAI implements ShipSystemAIScript {
024
025        protected ShipAPI ship;
026        protected CombatEngineAPI engine;
027        protected ShipwideAIFlags flags;
028        protected ShipSystemAPI system;
029        protected EnergyLashSystemScript script;
030        
031        protected IntervalUtil tracker = new IntervalUtil(0.5f, 1f);
032        
033        public void init(ShipAPI ship, ShipSystemAPI system, ShipwideAIFlags flags, CombatEngineAPI engine) {
034                this.ship = ship;
035                this.flags = flags;
036                this.engine = engine;
037                this.system = system;
038                
039                script = (EnergyLashSystemScript)system.getScript();
040        }
041        
042        public void advance(float amount, Vector2f missileDangerDir, Vector2f collisionDangerDir, ShipAPI target) {
043                tracker.advance(amount);
044                
045                if (tracker.intervalElapsed()) {
046                        if (system.getCooldownRemaining() > 0) return;
047                        if (system.isOutOfAmmo()) return;
048                        if (system.isActive()) return;
049                        if (ship.getFluxTracker().isOverloadedOrVenting()) return;
050                        
051                        ShipAPI pick = getWeightedTargets(target).getItemWithHighestWeight();
052                        if (pick != null) {
053                                ship.getAIFlags().setFlag(AIFlags.CUSTOM1, 1.5f, pick);
054                                ship.giveCommand(ShipCommand.USE_SYSTEM, null, 0);
055                                //System.out.println("Lash target: " + pick);
056                        }
057                }
058        }
059        
060        public List<ShipAPI> getPossibleTargets() {
061                List<ShipAPI> result = new ArrayList<>();
062                CombatEngineAPI engine = Global.getCombatEngine();
063                
064                List<ShipAPI> ships = engine.getShips();
065                for (ShipAPI other : ships) {
066                        if (other == ship) continue;
067                        if (!script.isValidLashTarget(ship, other)) continue;
068                        if (!script.isInRange(ship, other)) continue;
069                        result.add(other);
070                }
071                return result;
072        }
073        
074        public WeightedRandomPicker<ShipAPI> getWeightedTargets(ShipAPI shipTarget) {
075                WeightedRandomPicker<ShipAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<>();
076                
077                for (ShipAPI other : getPossibleTargets()) {
078                        float w = 0f;
079                        if (ship.getOwner() == other.getOwner()) {
080                                if (ThreatSwarmAI.isAttackSwarm(other)) {
081                                        RoilingSwarmEffect swarm = RoilingSwarmEffect.getSwarmFor(other);
082                                        if (swarm instanceof DwellerShroud) swarm = null;
083                                        if (swarm != null && !VoltaicDischargeOnFireEffect.isSwarmPhaseMode(other)) {
084                                                w = 0.5f;
085                                        } else {
086                                                continue;
087                                        }
088                                } else {
089                                        if (other.getSystem() == null) continue;
090                                        if (!(other.getSystem().getScript() instanceof EnergyLashActivatedSystem)) continue;
091                                        if (other.getSystem().getCooldownRemaining() > 0) continue;
092                                        if (other.getSystem().isActive()) continue;
093                                        if (other.getFluxTracker().isOverloadedOrVenting()) continue;
094                                        
095                                        EnergyLashActivatedSystem otherSystem = (EnergyLashActivatedSystem) other.getSystem().getScript();
096                                        w = otherSystem.getCurrentUsefulnessLevel(ship, other);
097                                }
098//                              if (other.getSystem().getSpecAPI().hasTag(Tags.SHIP_SYSTEM_MOVEMENT)) {
099//                              }
100//                              if (other.getSystem().getSpecAPI().hasTag(Tags.SHIP_SYSTEM_OFFENSIVE)) {
101//                                      Object test = ship.getAIFlags().getCustom(AIFlags.MANEUVER_TARGET);
102//                                      if (test instanceof ShipAPI) {
103//                                              ShipAPI otherTarget = (ShipAPI) test;
104//                                              float dist = Misc.getDistance(other.getLocation(), otherTarget.getLocation());
105//                                              dist -= other.getCollisionRadius() + otherTarget.getCollisionRadius();
106//                                              if (dist < 1500f) {
107//                                              }
108//                                      }
109//                              }
110                        } else {
111                                ShieldAPI targetShield = other.getShield();
112                                boolean targetShieldsFacingUs = targetShield != null &&
113                                                        targetShield.isOn() &&
114                                                        Misc.isInArc(targetShield.getFacing(), Math.max(30f, targetShield.getActiveArc()),
115                                                                        other.getLocation(), ship.getLocation());
116                                if (targetShieldsFacingUs && EnergyLashSystemScript.DAMAGE <= 0) continue;
117                                
118                                float dist = Misc.getDistance(ship.getLocation(), other.getLocation());
119                                dist -= ship.getCollisionRadius() + other.getCollisionRadius();
120                                if (dist < 0) dist = 0;
121                                if (other == shipTarget) {
122                                        w += 0.25f;
123                                }
124                                if (dist < 1000f) {
125                                        w += (1f - (dist / 1000f)) * 0.5f;
126                                }
127                                if (other.isPhased()) {
128                                        w += 0.5f;
129                                }
130                                w += 0.01f;
131                        }
132                        picker.add(other, w);
133                }
134                return picker;
135        }
136
137}
